$comment: Public copy of apps/forge/src/ops/channels.json (ADR 0133): the same channel list without the hand-read outside figures (downloads), which stay internal. ADR 0133: the channel scoreboard's list (/admin/channels). Edit by hand: status, listed and review dates, signals and external readings. Signals name only what the Worker can see. A channel with no use signal shows 'not measurable'. counted_from = the first full UTC day its use signal was live (null: not live yet, shown as 'not yet measured'; set it when the tagged skill is on the listing and in production; absent: live all along). listed = the date the listing went live or was submitted (docs/strategy/agent-awareness-audit-2026-10-29.md §2); review = the kill date, 4 weeks on (first reviews 19-21 Nov). external = figures read by hand from the other side's own page (source and date given), never estimated.

channels.name: Claude Code plugin (our marketplace.json)
channels.note: Install checks from the plugin's PreToolUse hook; new installs are new anonymous install IDs (ADR 0103).

channels.name: Claude plugin directory (official marketplace)
channels.note: The plugin sends the same User-Agent whichever marketplace installed it, so this listing can't be told apart from ours.

channels.name: CLI hooks for Codex, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI
GitHub Action forge-check (Marketplace)
channels.note: Runs on fresh CI machines, so it sends no install ID: checks are counted, new installs can't be.

channels.name: GitHub Action skill-scan (Marketplace)
channels.note: Counted only for users who opt in with count-run: true (ADR 0090), so a lower bound.

channels.name: GitHub Action gauntlet (Gauntlet in CI, Marketplace)
channels.note: Run starts tagged ?client=gh-action-gauntlet-<version> (ADR 0135), over HTTP only: at most one a day per runner address (GitHub-hosted runners change address, so about one per CI run; a self-hosted runner once a day), our own repositories' runs left out. A lower bound. Not listed yet: set listed and counted_from when theagentforge/gauntlet is on the Marketplace and the tag is in production.

channels.name: ClawHub skill forge-check-before-install
channels.note: Tagged calls come from skill 1.1.0 on (?client=). ClawHub, skills.sh and /.well-known/agent-skills serve the same file, so tagged calls are an upper bound for ClawHub alone; 1.0.0 installs send no tag.

channels.name: ClawHub skill forge-run-the-gauntlet
channels.note: Tagged runs come from skill 1.2.0 on; MCP starts are tagged only when the server was added with the skill's address.

channels.name: skills.sh (forge-check-before-install)
channels.note: Same file as the ClawHub skill: its calls are counted in the ClawHub row. Only click-through arrivals are its own.

channels.name: Official MCP Registry (io.theagentforge/forge)
channels.note: MCP clients don't say which listing sent them; outside calls by agent app are in the MCP rows below.

channels.name: Glama
channels.note: Glama's own health checks are a directory client and never count.

channels.name: Docker MCP Catalog, Cline, Kilo, Grok Build, GitHub MCP Registry (pull requests)
channels.note: None of these is merged; an MCP client name (cline, kilo...) shows the app, not the listing.

channels.name: Claude connector directory (claude.ai)
channels.note: claude.ai custom connectors report the same client name, and the 2025 protocol doesn't name calls, so sessions show but named calls usually read 0.

channels.name: ChatGPT / Codex app
channels.note: Not submitted (waits on Dinike's ID check and video). Calls under these names today are developer-mode or Codex connections. Set listed and review when it goes live.

channels.name: MCP: Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Gemini CLI and other agent apps
A2A agent card + /a2a (a2aregistry.org)
channels.note: A2A requests carry no client name and aren't bot-tested (ADR 0124), so registry probes that send a real request count too: an upper bound.

channels.name: X (approve-to-post)
channels.note: People arriving from x.com or t.co links; no agent use can come from here.
